name: RC-B10-0071/2026 – After § 5 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text: 5a. Calls on the Member States to urgently establish emergency protection pathways, including through humanitarian visas and temporary relocation schemes, for persons in Iran who are at immediate risk, notably protesters, journalists, artists, students and human rights defenders;
